# Comfy HappyHorse 1.1- Image to Video

Animate a static first frame into a short video with synchronized audio using HappyHorse 1.1, taking 1 input image and producing 1 video output. Ideal for e-commerce product demos, brand marketing content, and short episodic series. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_happyhorse1_1_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
